question: Look for FDA safety communications about montelukast. Summarize only the returned notice titles or excerpts, link to them, and explain if full notice text was not retrieved. No personal treatment recommendations.
answer:

**Known FDA safety communication (from established FDA material):**

- **“FDA requires Boxed Warning about serious mental health side effects for montelukast (Singulair); advises restricting use for allergic rhinitis”**  
  FDA, March 4, 2020.  
  https://www.fda.gov/news-events/fda-newsroom/press-announcements/fda-requires-boxed-warning-about-serious-mental-health-side-effects-montelukast-singulair  
  This FDA newsroom notice states that FDA required a boxed warning about serious neuropsychiatric events and advised restricting montelukast use for allergic rhinitis.
